Game Overview

In Brick Dodge, the core idea is straightforward: navigate the chaos of Brick Dodge, where relentless falling bricks test your agility and reflexes. Survive the ever-accelerating storm by deftly maneuvering your player icon, as the intensity escalates into a heart-pounding escapade. How long can you endure the challenging cascade and achieve a high score?
